contribution.position: My position on reliability is unchanged. The perf report measures peak CPU at 93% against a 70% budget. The QA turn cites 55% from the same report, which conflicts with the artifact text, so the 93% figure should be treated as the one on record until it is reconciled. The incident log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both from retry storms, and a job near CPU saturation is where retries pile up and cascade. The passing test report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) supports functional correctness but does not show retry or backoff behavior under peak load. Evidence that would change my view: a peak-load test showing bounded retries, CPU back inside budget or the overage explicitly accepted, and confirmation that last quarter's retry-storm causes are fixed or capped.
